title: Dispatching the tile library’s loans
titleZh: 磁磚資料館的外借品運送
passage:
Packing instruction | Moss Harbor Ceramic Tile Library
Each tile loan travels in a reusable tray. A tray marked D contains display tiles only, and a tray marked H contains handling samples that visitors may touch. Put loose labels in the envelope clipped inside the lid. Do not tape a label to a tile, even for a short trip.

Courier bulletin | Monday pickup
The morning driver can take either type of tray but does not obtain signatures at delivery. The afternoon driver picks up at 3:30 p.m. and can collect a signature from the receiving staff. Wet-weather covers are available at the loading desk; keep the tray flat even when a cover is fitted.

Message | Kei to packing desk
On Monday, please send the display tray from our packing desk to South Hall’s borrowing desk. That delivery needs a signed handoff record. Send the visitor handling samples to the other site; that delivery needs no signature and can leave before lunch. Rain is expected; please fit weather covers to both loads.
passageZh:
裝箱說明｜苔港磁磚資料館
外借磁磚都用可重複使用的托盤運送。標有 D 的托盤只裝展示磁磚，標有 H 的托盤裝訪客可以觸摸的樣品。散放的標籤請裝入夾在盒蓋內側的信封。即使只運送一小段距離，也不要把標籤黏到磁磚上。

快遞公告｜星期一取件
上午司機可運送兩類托盤，但不辦理送達簽收。下午的司機於三點半取件，可向收件人員取得簽名。裝貨櫃檯提供防雨套；即使套上防雨套，也須讓托盤保持水平。

訊息｜Kei 給裝箱櫃檯
星期一請由我們的裝箱櫃檯把展示托盤送到南館借用櫃檯。這批須取得簽名交接紀錄。供訪客觸摸的樣品送往另一個場地，不必簽收，可以在中午前出貨。預計會下雨，兩批貨都請套上防雨套。
